pool2_clean.interpretation: At k=1 a candidate at the day's LEAST-correlated extreme gains a full 1.0 of adjusted score over one at the MOST-correlated extreme, and that extreme-to-extreme gap corresponds to 0.543 of raw correlation. A one-decile percentile move -- closer to what the admission boundary actually sees -- corresponds to about 0.0284 of raw correlation.
